statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The service was ordered to capture and correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The denial reason code is CO-50
The service was not deemed medically necessary under current coverage guidelines
